scope_summary: Provide five Agent Mode audit prompts for the One Time UI audit covering control tower, public funnel, Rabbi operations/backend, portals/classroom, and cross-system synthesis.
expected_outputs: Repo-visible audit packets created for each prompt with findings and evidence
Codex pickup of resulting audit packets for analysis
acceptance_criteria: Prompts run in the correct order (control tower first, then surface audits, then synthesis)
Each resulting audit agent creates a dropoff packet with status set to ready_for_codex_audit
No secrets or prohibited data included in any prompt or report
